name: cable standing hip extension v. 3
description: A standing cable kickback that targets the glutes. It teaches you to extend the hip without arching your back.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand facing the machine, holding on for balance.
Keep your core tight and your torso upright.
Push your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
